title: PixelKin - A Trainer Spots You (the startle)
_note: The PLAY-ONCE head of trainer-eyes: one 4/4 bar at 152 BPM (~1.58 s). Eyes meet: a brass E7 hit + crash on the downbeat while the lead SHOOTS up an E7 arpeggio in sixteenths, a pulse glide sweeps two octaves up underneath (the alarm whoosh), a high G#-to-B 'eek' crests on beat 3 with a second hit, and a two-note pickup (B4-D5) tips into the loop body's A-minor downbeat. Ends on the harmonic-minor dominant, never resolved - the resolution is the loop starting. Stitched in front of trainer-eyes-loop by tools/audio/stitch_intro_loop.py; loop_start = the end of this bar. Original (VISION.md).
